newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were steady on Friday on the Beirut Stock Exchange with Banque Audi closing at $18.25 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce at $13.125.
Solidere shares were mixed with Solidere A shares unchanged from Thursday's $10.25 and B shares down to $10.625 from $10.75.
Turnover in BLC was 10,000 shares from 5,500 a day earlier and 10,253 Audi shares changed hands against 10,134.
Demand for Solidere A shares remained high with 109,000 shares changing hands from 105,960 a day earlier. This compared with a daily turnover of 40-50,000 in previous weeks and 80-100,000 last week.
Also traded were some 10,000 Ciments Libanais shares at $1.5625, unchanged from March 3 when they were last traded.
Lebanon Invest Bank Share Index (LIBX), introduced by Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest on Tuesday, held steady at 113.60.
LIBX takes its base as 100 on January 20, 1997, the day Banque Audi became the second bank traded on the Bourse.
Total BSE turnover was 178,330 shares for a value of $1,864,123 against 175,244 shares for a value of $1,765,899 on Thursday.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.35 percent to 894.09 and the LISPI also fell 0.12 percent to 82.37.
